authority: none — successor-scoped, unregistered, cites nothing as authority

specializes.note: scoped entailment: the source must be true whenever the target is true, within the source's scope. Not usable for merely related propositions.

note: External references (ADRs, pelaggio node ids) are recorded in a node's `sources` field, never as edge targets. An edge target must resolve to a node in this corpus.

nodes.statement: A worker cannot cause a consequential effect. It may declare intent; causing the effect is the harness's act.

The authority required to permit an effect scales with the effect's reversibility and with the harm class of what it can carry. Below the threshold the harness's own computation suffices; at or above it, permission requires an authority that exists outside the run and whose absence is itself a refusal. A safety-class defect is never below the threshold, whatever the mechanical reversibility of its carrier.
A refusal is computed by the harness from typed inputs. A judgment may be an input to that computation; it is never the computation. The absence of a required input is a refusal, not a pass.
Every dispatched effect is witnessed by a record the declaring party can neither produce nor alter.
A refusal never destroys authored work. Any path that ends an attempt without advancing it names the state it preserved and the handle that resumes it.
The execution environment is a function of its declared inputs, and any divergence from that function is resolved without consulting the diverged state.
Every terminal outcome carries a type sufficient to select its response.
Intent quality is recorded when work is chartered. Where it is insufficient, that is established by attempting the work and failing to produce, never by refusing admission.
A repair stays inside the property its item owns. Work outside that property becomes separate work with a recorded relation, unless this delivery caused it.
Integration order derives from one authoritative atomic state, not from several mutually reconstructed ones.
What reaches a human is bounded. What is recorded is not.
A guarantee that must hold at many sites holds at sites not yet written. A violation site added later is subject to it without that site being amended.

A declaration authored by the guarded party may select among closed, harness-owned operations, but may not supply an authorization, a proof, or a verdict. Enforcement may not depend on a surface the harness strips before execution.

A guard may not destroy an actor's work on evidence it cannot attribute to that actor. Refusing an action because a target precondition no longer holds is permitted; discarding authored work on an ambient delta is not.

Admission to work may not be refused on an assessment of quality. A refusal after an attempt may cite a recorded assessment as an input, provided the refusal itself is computed and the assessment's author is named.
An advisory signal may not change a disposition on its own, and an absent or empty signal yields no refusal.
A model may not narrow human-owned intent. A narrowing requires supersede through human re-chartering, never an in-flight decision record.
Recovery may not depend on reproducing nondeterministic behaviour, and a resumed attempt may not adopt a prior identity without positive corroboration.

Prospective authorization, the witness of what was dispatched, and delivery of that witness downstream are three separable obligations. The witness is durable before the effect is acknowledged; where an effect may have occurred without acknowledgement, the outcome is unresolved and no retry proceeds without positive evidence of non-occurrence. Downstream delivery alone may degrade to omission.
A self-asserted outcome kind must name the resolvable entity it collided with. A claim that cannot name one is not of that kind.

The dispositions of a finding are totally ordered and mutually exclusive in effect: a defect this delivery caused is item-owned before any scope or breadth test is applied, and where more than one disposition matches, the earliest in the order governs.
An outcome type may not be recovered by interpreting free text at the point of consumption. Kinds that differ in their correct response are distinguishable by value.
Diagnostics, ordering mechanisms and prechecks may not be counted as load-bearing enforcement.
A bound on what reaches a human may not be the only record of what it withheld, and may not be adjusted by the party it protects without that adjustment being observable.

The bound on what reaches a human is aggregate, not per-lineage: it covers the number of crossings and the size of each, across all concurrent lineages. Material withheld to stay within it remains recorded in full.
A reversibility classification is assigned by the harness from the effect's own kind, never by the party seeking to perform it.
The declared inputs of an environment may not include state produced within a previous instance of that environment. A derivation that consults its own residue is a repair wearing derivation's name.
Reversibility is decidable from an effect's kind at declaration time, without executing it.
nodes.wrongIf: An effect kind is found whose reversibility or harm class cannot be decided from the kind alone at declaration time — whether because it depends on unobservable runtime state or because the same kind spans both bands.

nodes.statement: Resolving environment divergence without consulting the diverged state is affordable at cycle frequency.
nodes.wrongIf: Re-derivation at cycle frequency is unaffordable — either its per-cycle cost exceeds the cost of the failures it removes, or its latency exceeds the cycle budget it runs inside.

nodes.statement: Human attention is the binding constraint on progress, and is bounded independently of how many faults occur.
nodes.wrongIf: Attention demand tracks fault volume rather than saturating, or progress remains bounded while attention is available and unspent.

nodes.statement: Review internal to a cycle surfaces enough for the disposition set to operate on.
nodes.wrongIf: Findings that an external reviewer would have raised are absent from internal review on a sample where both ran — not merely that disposition counts are low, which is also consistent with there being no defects.

nodes.statement: The four dispositions named in DEC-8 partition the space of surviving findings.
nodes.wrongIf: A real finding matches none of the four dispositions, or matches more than one with no precedence resolving it, or one proves an attribute of another rather than a peer.

nodes.statement: Consequential intent is expressed as a declared manifest over a closed set of kinds, dispatched at a single seam, rather than performed in place.

Each effect kind carries a harness-assigned reversibility class. Classes above the threshold require an authority independent of the declaring party; classes below dispatch on the harness's own authority, and that grant is itself recorded.
The witness is a content-addressed record written at the dispatch boundary before the declaration is destroyed, binding the declaration, the realized actor, and the source revision.
Charter quality is a recorded lint. A worker that cannot produce a correct result emits a typed outcome naming the anchor it failed against, rather than proceeding on a guess.

A suspended outcome carries a kind; the kind selects the response, and every kind discharges a preservation obligation before that response is taken. A retry is attempted only where a retry could change the result.

Faults are handled by nested supervision: respond at the narrowest scope that could resolve the fault, escalate to the enclosing scope when repeated response fails to resolve it, and cross the human boundary once, carrying the lineage.
An execution environment is established by derivation from declared inputs. Divergence is resolved by re-derivation, preceded by preserving anything authored within it.

Every surviving finding carries one of four dispositions — inside the item's property, outside it, a claim broader than its mechanism, or not holding at this revision — and the disposition selects the route.
Integration order is serialized by compare-and-swap against observed authoritative state, with verification bound to the candidate and ancestry established independently.
A guarantee over many sites is established by making one path the only path, and the exclusivity of that path is asserted by a check that fails when a second appears.
